title: Section 7.5 polynomial degree first pass
subtitle: Disk support, arcs and S-curves, normalize_coords = True, clean local-patch evaluation

config.apparatus_reduction: Metrics are measured on centered local patches rather than full 1024^2 frames. The features are isolated, the largest support radius is 25 px, and the evaluation mask is confined to a local tangent-normal neighborhood around the curved edge, so the reduced patch fully contains every neighborhood that can influence the reported errors.

stimuli.arc: Circular-arc level set rendered as 0.5 * (1 + tanh(phi / w)) with exact analytical gradient.
stimuli.s_curve: Odd cubic inflection curve rendered as 0.5 * (1 + tanh(phi / w)) with exact analytical gradient.

config.evaluation_mask_definition: |phi| <= 6 px and |v| <= 2r in the local tangent-normal coordinates.
config.csv_metric_average: CSV rows average metrics over orientations, sub-pixel phases, and both stimulus classes.
